title: Otori Emu — Quack ☆ A Ducky Endeavor!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Phoenix in the Distant Sky

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Robo-Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Too slow.
Honestly, where are you looking? Are you not going to catch me?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Stop!
I'm going to catch you no matter what!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Robo-Phoenix seems to be having no trouble flying and moving around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we should try practicing just as hard as Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I think I'll do some basic strength exercises and go for a run around the park afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll sit here and keep reading through the script, while also keeping an eye on Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What about you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go find some ducks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To get into character as the Featherbrained Duck, yes? You should be able to find some by the pond.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll head over there now☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sneak...
Sneaky sneak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, my duckies...!
Slooowly... I shouldn't scare them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'll start by observing them like Sakurako was talking about!)

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Quack! Quack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, they sorta glide across the water as they swim!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hmm... That one's pecking at a leaf on the surface of the water... Does it think it's food or something?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (More are gathering in a big hurry... They must all have a big appetite!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, this sort of stuff should be in an encyclopedia! After I get home, I'll try borrowing the one Keisuke had when he was little!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hm? There's a big duck and some ducklings in the grass way over on the other side.)

rows.Speaker: Big Duck
rows.Line: Quaack, quack...

rows.Speaker: Duckling
rows.Line: Peep, peeep.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It is a mom with her babies? The ducklings seem to be following her lead and trying to groom themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Then, I'll try copying them! Time for some grooming!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Hnng... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... I don't think I can...
My neck just isn't long enough.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Still... Sakurako isn't actually a phoenix, but she totally looked like one on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I've never seen a real one before, but I ended up thinking, “It's a phoenix!”)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really don't know what I'm supposed to do here...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (For now, I just need to keep copying them!)

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Quack, quack! Quaack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Um... Spread my wings really wide and...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Quack, quack! Quaack!

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Quack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(It saw me!
Then...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good quack to you! May I quack what you are doing?

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Q-Quack...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Huh? It tilted its head.
Did it not understand what I was trying to say?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Then, I'll try again!
Raise your arms! Spread them even wider!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Quack! Quack, quaack, quack!!!
(Hello! I'm Emu Otori!!!)

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Q-Quack...! Quaaack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, it's spreading its wings now!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Maybe it's trying to show me how!
Oh, I need to tilt my hands at the right angle!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So twist my wrists like this? And tilt my elbows...like this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, the duck I'm playing is supposed to be kinda scatterbrained, so I can try waddling as I walk!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Quaaaack. Quaaaack.

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Q-Quaaack...!!!

rows.Speaker: Ducks
rows.Line: Quack? Quack...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the other ducks are starting to gather!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And they're all spreading their wings!
Is this their way of greeting each other? Quack, quack☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What in the world is she doing...? I think the ducks are forming a circle to try to intimidate her...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But they're getting very close to her without much hesitation. I don't see any running away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may be seeing her as one of them... Or rather... They're partly scared but also partly curious.

rows.Speaker: Duck
rows.Line: Quack...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Quack♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm gonna figure out my character by chatting up a storm with my feathery friends!)
